verdict.rationale: Context.dev's extraction guide explicitly describes providing a JSON Schema (not CSS selectors) and having the system 'crawl relevant pages and return an object that matches your JSON Schema' with grounding/coverage controls, i.e., LLM-driven field extraction rather than pre-written selectors (docs-4, docs-21). This is reinforced by contrast with the separate CSS-selector scrape option (docs-20), showing schema-based extraction is a distinct, selector-free path. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of extraction accuracy or field-inference quality beyond vendor docs, and no example showing the LLM inferring fields without any schema at all.
